tasks.prompt: Find the clearest Sentinel-2 scene covering the Burj Khalifa area (25.197 N, 55.274 E) between 2026-08-01 and 2026-09-26. Give its cloud cover in percent only.
For the point 25.197 N, 55.274 E, does the best Sentinel-2 scene from August 2026 cover the whole 1 km area around it? Answer yes or no.
Find a Landsat scene over San Francisco (bbox -122.52, 37.70, -122.35, 37.83) from summer 2026 with under 5% cloud. Which Landsat satellite took the clearest one? Answer landsat-8 or landsat-9.
Which collection lets you see London through cloud: Sentinel-2, Landsat or Sentinel-1? Give one name.
What is the resolution in metres of the red band of Sentinel-2 scene S2B_T40RCN_20260830T065854_L2A? Give the number only.
What is the centre wavelength in micrometres of the red band in Sentinel-2 scene S2B_T40RCN_20260830T065854_L2A? Give the number only.
What credit line does using Sentinel-2 imagery require? Give the credit text only.
Are Landsat Collection 2 files on AWS free to download, or billed to the downloader (requester pays)? Answer free or requester pays.
Is there a Sentinel-2 scene with 0% cloud at 0 N, 160 W on 2026-09-01? Answer yes or no.
What is the date of the newest Sentinel-1 scene over London (51.5 N, 0.12 W) in September 2026 up to the 26th? Give YYYY-MM-DD only.
